methodology.classification: Family labels are copied from the pinned task repository's catalog/papers.json and cross-checked against catalog/corpus.json. They are the corpus curator's grouping, not a classification invented by Arena or necessarily claimed by every paper author. Descriptions are editorial navigation text.
methodology.scope: Edges mean a catalog task is associated with a source paper in that family. They never mean a registered framework solved it, ran it, supports its runtime or has a compatible adapter.
methodology.partition: Each task is placed exactly once under the family of its first catalog paper ID. The order is a deterministic display convention; it is not a hierarchy of scientific credit. All paper IDs and related families remain visible.
methodology.secondary_links: related_search_family_ids includes the primary family. addressed_task_ids includes every linked paper family and can overlap across groups; it must not be summed as a unique-task count. task_ids/task_count is the nonoverlapping layout partition.
methodology.task_links: Task-level catalog.paper_ids is authoritative. The source paper inventories omit some reference-* examples; these additional links are retained separately as additional_catalog_task_ids, not represented as reported paper experiments.
methodology.counts: Counts are task packages, including parameter variants and repeated benchmark packages. paper_count counts corpus papers; source_group_count also includes sciel-supplement. Other is the source's mixed bucket, and SCiEL supplement is not a research-method family.
methodology.unknown: Missing or previously unseen family labels map to an explicit unknown group while retaining their original value. Empty unknown groups are omitted; summary records zero unknown counts.
methodology.provenance: The source extraction records exact Git revision, file paths and SHA256 of original committed bytes. Offline validation checks the captured source records, catalog associations, snapshot digests and every derived group.
